refs.note: Its description 'quotes in large part the National Register Nomination for the Bowen House written by Mardges Bacon in 1976' and states 'Commissioned in 1845, built in 1846, this Gothic Revival house with servant's ell to the southwest'. It also records 'Recorded by Historic American Buildings Survey: [Photographs only: HABS Photographs 70-543-1 through 70-543-80]', which is the second surface confirming that no written data exists.
